chapter: Pianists, the district and Stormy Weather
title: Cooney, Lulu White and an actress in France
summary: He cannot place Cooney, then recounts an actress in France asking about Lulu White of 235 Basin Street and his visits in the kitchen.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Mm. Did you know a guy named Cooney? Cooney? Yeah. He was a Tom Anderson. There had been a woman. A singer. Cooney? Yeah, I know Cooney. Was it a man or a woman or what? It was a man. Cooney. Did he play an afternoon?

No, I never knew anything to play an afternoon. Cooney, I know. A lot of those guys, but I forget their names. It's like Louis White. When I was in France, I was sitting in the audience and an actress, she must have been a little bit of a woman. She asked, she said, is anybody here from the Orleans? I raised my hand up. I said, yeah, I'm from the Orleans. She said, well, come up here. I'm going to ask you something. And I went up there and I said, what do you want to ask her, miss? She said, I want to ask her, did you know a little wife? I said, yeah, I know a little wife. She lived at 235 Basin Street. You guys know anything? 235 Basin Street. I said, well, I know her. She said, well, I know her. She said, you speak French mighty good. I told her, I'm going to ask her, did you know a little wife? I said, yeah, I know a little wife. She lived at 235 Basin Street. You guys know her? 235 Basin Street. Well, I used to go to the Locked Rock Street. You know what I mean?
Well, this actress knew her, huh?
Yeah, the actress. She said, I've been there and stopped there. I said, well, I know her. She said, you speak French mighty good. I told her I speak French too. I mean, they always.
You mean this was a French woman?
I don't know if she was French, but I told her I speak French, you know?
Yeah, and she worked for Lulu? No, she was, even Lulu had girls working in there.

Yeah. All kinds. Yeah. Brooms, brunettes, and everything, you know? Anyone you want to pick. You know what I mean? Roseanne in that house, 26. I didn't even know how many brooms they had in there. Were you in all of them? No, all of them, no. I was in the kitchen. Where the food is. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
